simple.meaning: to strike (lightly or severely, literally or figuratively)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to נָכָה (H5221) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 502 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: נָכָה (nâkâh) means to strike (lightly or severely, literally or figuratively) First listed occurrence: 1Chr 1 46.
